scope.question: Can DONCH4H be treated as a validated standalone profitable sleeve or promoted into PAPER shadow?
actions: Audited the exact shared strategy and capital-constrained portfolio simulator
Compared repository headline claims with simulator provenance comments
Queried the preserved MANAGER-RESET-20261007 PAPER archive read-only
Did not rerun exposed validation or change trading state

findings.evidence: backtest/portfolio.ts states v80bt measured DONCH4H alone at -46.9% and ROTA+DONCH4H at +70.1%; DONCH4H was profitable only on capital left after ROTA.
findings.implication: The combined result is not evidence of positive standalone expectancy. If ROTA exits or its health switch unwinds, DONCH4H can inherit the losing full-book configuration.

findings.evidence: shared/strategy.ts and backtest/portfolio.ts state v79bt reproduced approximately the signal count (11,412 vs 11,218) but not the documented window profile.
findings.implication: The older 36-month headline cannot be treated as reproduced by the exact live-rule, capital-constrained engine.

findings.evidence: The simulator default makerFillRate is 1.0; its own comment says all prior backtests silently assumed every resting ladder leg filled as maker. Funding is a fixed 0.0001 per 8h model, not symbol/time historical funding.
findings.implication: Execution costs and fill probability are optimistic or approximated; they cannot rescue a negative standalone result.

findings.evidence: DONCH window, ADX gate, ATR stop, ladder and trailing constants are annotated as selected/re-tuned across many batches, including thresholds chosen because alternatives made a window negative.
findings.implication: The published validation windows are exposed and heavily selected; they are not a clean holdout.

findings.evidence: backtest/portfolio.ts says all runs before v83bt omitted the live health kill-switch.
findings.implication: Pre-v83 portfolio headlines do not have full live-rule parity.

findings.evidence: No durable raw v80bt result artifact was found on main; the -46.9% and +70.1% figures survive as source-code provenance comments.
findings.implication: The figures are sufficient to reject activation, but not sufficient to certify any alternative configuration.

findings.evidence: The preserved reset archive contains 52 Q15 rows with aggregate stored PnL -1444.1334 and zero DONCH4H rows.
findings.implication: There is no preserved forward PAPER sample for DONCH4H. The Q15 loss is unrelated and must not be presented as DONCH4H evidence.

decision.rationale: A negative standalone result plus unreproduced window profile, optimistic fill assumptions and exposed tuning cannot meet the research gate.

next_valid_test_if_revisited: Use a genuinely new time period and preferably a point-in-time universe
Run LONG and SHORT contributions separately and combined
Use observed maker fill sensitivity, taker fallback and actual historical funding
Run exact portfolio interaction with ROTA health-switch behavior
Require PF > 1.15, positive average net and at least 300 trades separately in train and untouched validation
Require a new forward Shadow and portfolio analysis before PAPER activation
limitations: The exposed historical validation was not retuned or reused to manufacture a passing variant.
No durable raw v80bt artifact was available on main for independent metric recomputation.
The preserved PAPER archive has no DONCH4H observations.
